title: Symplectic Balls in Symmetric Polar Products
summary: For every integer n ≥ 2 and every origin-symmetric convex body $`K\subset\mathbb R^n`$, we prove that the Gromov width of $`\mathop{\mathrm{int}}\nolimits K\times\mathop{\mathrm{int}}\nolimits K^\circ`$ is 4. We construct smooth symplectic embeddings of standard balls of every capacity $`0\lt c\lt 4`$ into this polar product. Volume preservation then resolves the symmetric Mahler conjecture positively in every dimension.
family_title: The Mahler conjectures, functional inequalities and polar-product symplectic width

review.reason: Computes the Gromov width of symmetric polar products and relates it to the symmetric Mahler conjecture.
